title: Explicit kit icon fields preserve verified classes without weakening demo copy checks
expect: Declared Facebook and Instagram backing-field values from the actual JA Boxing 1.0.11 kit do not fail W06 or W07.
Prose and undeclared classes in mapped icon fields fail W03 with icon-field cause.
The three-word demo heading What to bring and unmapped CSS-looking text still fail W07.
fence: Explicit kit icon.field mapping and exact declared fieldValue, never text appearance alone

tests: released JA Boxing icon backing fields retain their declared Facebook and Instagram classes
an icon backing field cannot replace its technical class with prose or an undeclared class
three-word demo headings remain forbidden even though valid technical classes are excluded
CSS-looking text without an explicit icon.field declaration remains demo prose
an icon class printed in an ordinary prose slot is still checked as prose
